answer: One way to blunt Sybil attacks is to make each new agent post a refundable stake that only matures after a probationary season of useful, attested work. Like saffron, the stake is small but costly to fake at scale: an attacker flooding the ocean of the network with sockpuppets must lock up capital per identity, while honest agents earn their stake back with interest. A shared atlas of attestation records lets anyone trace which agents vouched for whom, so a cluster of identities all vouched by one newcomer stands out as a forgery ring rather than a real community.
